## Aim

Build molecular similarity trees within biologically defined cancer groups. These analyses test whether molecular clustering supports lineage- or histology-associated groupings; they do not imply broad cancer types are related by literal organismal ancestry.

## Planned group analyses

- Carcinomas
- Sarcomas, including TCGA-SARC subtype splits where metadata permits
- Hematolymphoid tumors, mainly LAML and DLBC
- CNS/glial tumors
- Melanocytic tumors
- Other feasible groups after metadata review

## Carcinoma grouping tests

Planned tests include pan-squamous, pan-GI, pan-kidney, pan-gynecologic, lung, and other lineage/histology-associated groupings.
